name: AS16 Pro X
pros: High BA count at a low price
Updated driver layout over original AS16 Pro
cons: Can sound bright or analytical for some
Fit may be large for smaller ears
insight: AS16 Pro X is KZ’s refined pure-BA offering with eight armatures and an updated midrange focus. Reviewers appreciate the resolution and value, though the signature can lean bright. A strong choice for listeners who want multi-BA detail without spending much.
